hardcoreTodo.disableOverdueProductivity: Cannot disable Strict Deadline on an overdue task.
hardcoreTodo.missingDueDateGamified: In Hardcore Mode, To-Dos require a due date.
hardcoreTodo.missingDueDateProductivity: With Strict Deadline enabled, To-Dos require a due date.
hardcoreTodo.pastDueDateGamified: A Hardcore To-Do due date cannot be in the past.
hardcoreTodo.pastDueDateProductivity: A Strict Deadline To-Do due date cannot be in the past.

habitStages.initialExplanation: Initial stage: 100% of base reward ({baseCoinsFormatted}). At {adaptationThreshold} repetitions, it will enter the adaptation stage (-25%).
habitStages.adaptationExplanation: Adaptation stage ({currentCount}/{adaptationThreshold} repetitions). Pays 75% of base ({baseCoinsFormatted}). At {habitFormedThreshold}, it will adjust to 50%.
habitStages.formedExplanation: Formed habit ({currentCount}/{habitFormedThreshold} repetitions). Pays 50% of base ({baseCoinsFormatted}) to prevent inflation and encourage new habits!

dailyStages.bonusExplanation: Consistency bonus active ({currentCount}/{threshold} scheduled completions)! You earn +10% on base ({baseCoinsFormatted} -> {finalCoinsFormatted}) with no decay.
dailyStages.baseExplanation: Routine at full yield: 100% of base reward ({baseCoinsFormatted}), with no decay. Reaching {threshold} consecutive scheduled completions ({currentCount}/{threshold}) unlocks a +10% bonus.

todoStages.lateHardcoreExplanation: To-Do completed past due in Hardcore Mode. Reward reduced by 50% ({baseCoinsFormatted} -> {finalCoinsFormatted}).
todoStages.lateStrictExplanation: To-Do completed past its Strict Deadline. Reward reduced by 50% ({baseCoinsFormatted} -> {finalCoinsFormatted}).
todoStages.standardExplanation: To-Do tasks always award 100% of their difficulty reward upon completion.

notices.habitProgressExplanation: Full reward at the start. As you consolidate the habit ({adaptation} and {formed} reps), gains gradually adjust to 75% and 50%.
notices.hardcorePenaltyMessage: Failures or delays apply a -50% penalty on rewards.

rewards.itemZeroGamified: Backpack leisure items do not grant XP or Coins.
rewards.itemZeroProductivity: Inventory leisure items do not grant Points or Credits.
rewards.minTimeZeroReason: Sessions shorter than {minMinutes} min do not qualify for rewards.
rewards.minTimeGamified: Sessions under {minMinutes} min do not earn XP or Coins.
rewards.minTimeProductivity: Sessions under {minMinutes} min do not earn Points or Credits.
rewards.maxCapGamified: Time beyond {maxMinutes} min per session does not grant extra coins (anti-AFK).
rewards.maxCapProductivity: Time beyond {maxMinutes} min per session does not grant extra credits. Pause briefly before the next cycle.
rewards.deepWorkMessage: Extended uninterrupted session qualifies for the maximum bonus (+{coins}/cycle)!
rewards.dailyHardCapZeroReason: Daily reward cap ({hours}h) reached for this day.
rewards.dailyHardCapMessageGamified: You have already accumulated 8h of rewarded focus on this day. Time will be logged, but without extra XP/Coins.
rewards.dailyHardCapMessageProductivity: You have already accumulated 8h of rewarded focus today. Time is still tracked in analytics, preserving rest against burnout.
rewards.dailyDiminishingMessage: Daily focus stair-step: 4h–6h yields 50%, 6h–8h yields 25%, and above 8h yields 0%.
